spans.s:
ind.
An imitative sound, expressive of sobbing, &c.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Solitary, secret, private.
m. (-न्दः)
1 Meaning, intention, purport, opinion.
2

Poison.
n. (-न्दं)
Wish, desire.
E.
छद to cover, affix घञ्: see छन्दस्.

m. (-नः)
A hypocrite, a pretended and false ascetic.
E.
छन्द subjection, (of all human beings,) and पातन obtaining, from पत to go, affix ल्युट्; also छन्दकपातन.

n. (-न्दः)
1 Poetical metre of every kind, but it is also applicable particularly to the metre of the

Meaning, purport, object, intention.
3 Wish, desire.
4 The Vedas or scripture.
5 Wilfulness, independence, uncontrolled or unrestrained conduct.
E.
चदि to gladden, &c. and असुन् Uṇādi affix, च is changed to छ; also in some senses with a final vowel छन्द, q. v.

n. (-तं)
A holy verse.
E.
छन्दस्, and कृत made.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Made or done at will or according to one's wish.
E.
छन्दस् inclination, and यत् aff.

m. (-गः)
A reciter, or chanter of the Sāma Veda.
E.
छन्दस् the metre of the Vedas, and ग who sings.

n. (-त्तं)
Humouring, indulgence.
E.
छन्दस् will, and अनुवृत्त conforming to.

Covered.
E.
छद to cover, affix क्त.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Relating to poetical metre, to the Vedas, &c.
m. (-सः)
A priest conversant with scripture.
E.
छन्दस्, and अण् aff.

A celebrated Upaniṣad of the Sāma Veda.
E.
छान्दस् belonging to the Vedas, ग who goes, and क्य affix of habitude or practice.
